data.name: CoverageAvailable
data.value: Only available public sources are checked. Notices may be delayed or missed.

data.name: CoverageLimited
data.value: Coverage is limited. Some public sources are unavailable; notices may be delayed or missed.

data.name: CoverageDisabled
data.value: Announcement checks are off. Quota monitoring continues.

data.name: SuggestCancelled
data.value: This planned reset was cancelled. Arrange your work around the quota currently available.

data.name: SuggestPassed
data.value: The announced time has passed; no refill has been observed here yet.

data.name: SuggestUnknown
data.value: The time or eligibility is not confirmed for your plan. Arrange work around the quota currently available.

data.name: SuggestObserved
data.value: An official reset was announced and a refill was observed here around the same time. The account-specific cause is unknown.

data.name: SuggestCompleted
data.value: The source reports that the reset took place. No refill has been observed on this PC yet.

data.name: SuggestPlannedWork
data.value: If you already have important work planned, you could use the remaining quota before the announced reset.

data.name: SuggestKeepReset
data.value: If your work can wait, consider keeping your full reset for now.

data.name: SuggestNeutral
data.value: Arrange usage around your existing work and watch for quota updates.

data.name: EvidenceProbable
data.value: A comparable refill was observed around the announced time. This is a probable correlation; the cause remains unknown.

data.name: EvidenceNotComparable
data.value: Local observations cannot be compared reliably. An official notice does not establish this account's reset cause.

data.name: EvidenceNoObservation
data.value: No comparable refill is linked to this notice. An official announcement does not prove this account's reset cause.

data.name: SuggestCreditGrant
data.value: This notice grants a reset credit; it does not automatically refill your quota.

data.name: SuggestMechanism
data.value: This describes reset options or purchases, not an automatic quota refill.
